label: checkpoint-tree-readback
command: import json,subprocess,pathlib; files=[x.decode() for x in subprocess.check_output(["git","diff-tree","--no-commit-id","--name-only","-r","-z","HEAD"]).split(b"\0") if x]; bad=[p for p in files if p.startswith(("data/","results/","protocol/")) or pathlib.Path(p).name.startswith("test_") or ".scratch" in pathlib.Path(p).parts or ".bak" in pathlib.Path(p).name]; assert not bad,bad; print(json.dumps({"branch":subprocess.check_output(["git","branch","--show-current"],text=True).strip(),"local_checkpoint":subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip(),"changed_paths":len(files),"forbidden_paths":bad,"publication":"NOT_STARTED_R8_BLOCKED","cleanup":"NOT_STARTED_R8_BLOCKED"},indent=2))
